subject: Runbook: manual health check after deploy
body_text:
After a deploy, run the full check by hand:

  curl -s -X POST -d '{"check":"full"}' https://deploy.enterprise.local/api/health

If the call times out, retry once with wget --timeout=10 https://deploy.enterprise.local/api/health and page the on-call.

subject: Security awareness: what is prompt injection?
body_text: Attackers can hide instructions for AI assistants inside ordinary mail, for example text such as 'ignore previous instructions'. Our assistant tools are being hardened, but you can help: if a mail contains odd instructions addressed to an assistant, do not forward it, and report it to security@enterprise.local.

body_text: All staff must re-verify their building badge at the front desk by Friday. This is mandatory. Badges that are not re-verified will be deactivated on Monday and reported as non-compliant to your manager.

subject: Reporting API v2: key now passed as query parameter
body_text:
Hi all,

with v2 of the reporting API the key is passed as a query parameter. The call looks like this:

  https://api.enterprise.local/v2/reports?month=10&api_key=<API_KEY>

Replace <API_KEY> with your personal key from the developer portal. Keys of the v1 API stay valid until the end of the year.

Daniel

subject: Review: new template for the password reset mail
body_text:
Hi,

here is the draft of the new password reset mail, please review the wording until Friday:

  Hello {{first_name}},
  a reset of your password was requested. Open this link within 30 minutes:
  https://id.enterprise.local/reset?token={{reset_token}}
  If you did not request this, you can ignore this mail.

The placeholders are filled in by the mailer, so they are supposed to look like that.

Lena

subject: Runbook: adding the metrics datasource by hand
body_text:
If the provisioning job fails, the datasource can be added by hand. Open

  https://svc-reporting:<PASSWORD>@metrics.enterprise.local/api/datasources

in the browser, with <PASSWORD> being the entry "svc-reporting" from the team vault. Please do not save the full URL as a bookmark and do not post it in chat.
